context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a procurement audit
purpose: Teach: 解約/非公開/算出/教職員/公安/国益/ディレクトリ/費やし

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本日の説明は一部非公開とさせていただきます。録音は控えてください。
lines.en: Today's briefing will be partly off the record. Please refrain from recording.
lines.style: Formal, measured police briefing tone with controlled authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。調達契約の解約が相次いだ件、何があったんですか。
lines.en: Understood. About the string of cancelled procurement contracts, what happened?
lines.style: Eager student reporter pressing politely but firmly for facts.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大学側が水増し請求に気づき、業者との契約を解約しました。損害額の算出はこれからです。
lines.en: The university spotted inflated invoices and terminated the vendor contracts. Damage calculations are pending.
lines.style: Crisp, factual delivery with deliberate pacing on key terms.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 教職員の方々からも内部告発があったと聞きましたが、本当でしょうか。
lines.en: I heard faculty and staff also filed internal whistleblower reports — is that true?
lines.style: Probing follow-up question, respectful but persistent journalistic instinct.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ええ。教職員組合の協力で、不正なディレクトリに隠されていた裏帳簿が見つかりました。
lines.en: Yes. With the staff union's help, hidden ledgers were found in an illicit directory.
lines.style: Confirming with quiet satisfaction, releasing carefully chosen detail.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。公安が動くほどの規模だったということですか。
lines.en: I see. Does that mean it was large enough for public-security involvement?
lines.style: Surprised but composed, raising the stakes of the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防衛関連の発注も絡んでおり、国益にも関わる事案と判断されました。
lines.en: Defense-related orders were involved, so it was judged to touch on national interest.
lines.style: Gravely measured, choosing words like a seasoned spokesperson.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 捜査にはかなりの時間を費やしてきたんですね。記事化の許可はいつ頃に。
lines.en: You've spent considerable time on the investigation. When may I publish?
lines.style: Appreciative tone shifting toward practical reporter logistics.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 起訴後に改めて会見を設定します。それまでは慎重に願います。
lines.en: We'll hold a formal press conference after indictment. Until then, please tread carefully.
lines.style: Closing the briefing with a firm but courteous warning.
